subject: Meeting Next Week?
body:
Hi,

Hope you're having a great week!

I wanted to schedule a meeting for next week to discuss our ongoing partnership and explore new opportunities.

Are you available any of these times?
- Tuesday Feb 20: 2 PM - 4 PM
- Wednesday Feb 21: 10 AM - 12 PM
- Thursday Feb 22: 3 PM - 5 PM

Let me know what works best for you and I'll send over a calendar invite.

Looking forward to catching up!

Best,
Sarah Johnson
Partner Company
